page_count.value: 26 (14 main slides + 12 Q&A backup slides, as in the outline)

image_notes.value: Provided: the 15 project figures (300-dpi PNGs from figures/) are the evidence on every data slide; never cropped, never redrawn, so numbers match the report. Their orange (#EB6834) means 'the app/platform' and blue means 'our model'; that meaning stays fixed deck-wide. AI (decorative only, matching the reference sheet): a cover hero of a phone showing a delivery map with a floating 'Estimated arrival' card, a soft blue-tinted city skyline photo inside a large circular crop for the problem slide, and pale map-street textures for section backgrounds. If no image backend is available, these can be drawn as native vector shapes (map lines, pins, phone frame) instead. Proposed hero pages: P01 cover, P02 problem.

candidates.name: Follow the Order
candidates.note: The reference sheet as-is, with order #85188 as a floating 'order ticket' card that reappears on every slide it is mentioned, so the talk visibly follows one delivery.
candidates.mode_behavior: Story arc over the outline's five sections: Houston hook and question, meet order #85188, data and EDA, method, results, then the promise twist and the rider. Titles state the finding, not the topic. Each section opens with the reference's '01 ——' numbered kicker, and the order card returns on slides 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11 with the one number that slide adds. Backup slides answer Q&A plainly.
candidates.visual_style_behavior: Reference-sheet look: near-white field with large soft navy-to-ice gradient discs bleeding off one corner; generous rounded cards (about 16 px radius) with very soft shadows; icons inside pale rounded tiles; navy titles with the key word in electric blue; one big KPI tile per results slide (e.g. '6.49 min MAE'); 'Insight' callout cards with a short blue underline. Figures sit on white rounded cards with comfortable padding. Plenty of white space, one message per slide.

typography.name: Inter (Canva-safe stand-in for SF Pro Display) + Inter

image_strategy.name: Soft blue product imagery
image_strategy.visual: Clean product-style renders and photos washed in the deck's navy and ice blues: a phone with a delivery map, a city skyline, faint street-map textures
image_strategy.mood: Calm, modern, trustworthy, like a delivery app's own launch page
image_strategy.behavior: Smooth soft-lit 3D-ish product render for the phone, monochrome blue-tinted photography for the skyline, and very light line-art maps at low contrast so text sits on top. No harsh shadows, no saturated colors outside the blues, white space kept around every subject.

candidates.name: Results-First Grid
candidates.note: Same blues and fonts, but stricter and calmer: the finding goes in big type first, with a flat grid and almost no decoration so the figures dominate.
candidates.mode_behavior: Conclusion-first on every slide: the title is the finding, one short takeaway line, then the figure as evidence. Hooks stay in the speaker notes; order #85188 appears only as a small inline caption. Sections are marked with the numbered kicker only.
candidates.visual_style_behavior: Flat modular grid: square-ish cards with very small rounding, no shadows, thin divider rules, one large navy plane on section slides. Figures take two thirds of the slide, takeaway text flush left in the remaining third. Gradients only on the cover and the closing slide.

typography.name: Inter (Canva-safe stand-in for SF Pro Display) + Inter

image_strategy.name: Minimal blue line art
image_strategy.visual: Sparse line drawings of a map route and a city outline in navy on white
image_strategy.mood: Quiet and precise, like an architecture firm's report
image_strategy.behavior: Single-weight navy lines, no fills except one ice-blue plane, lots of empty space; used only on the cover and section slides.

candidates.name: Route Map Journey
candidates.note: Same blues and fonts, with the map from the reference sheet as the main motif: a delivery route line with pins runs across the deck and marks progress through the five sections.
candidates.mode_behavior: Story arc told as a delivery route: placed (problem), picked up (data), on the road (method), arrived (results), the promise (twist). Each section slide shows the route with the current pin filled in; content slides keep a thin route strip at the top.
candidates.visual_style_behavior: Pale street-map texture behind section slides, a curved electric-blue route line with map pins as the recurring progress bar, rounded cards with soft shadows for figures, pin-shaped markers for key numbers. More decoration than the other two, but always light and low-contrast.
